labels.name: Trapezius
labels.function: Elevates, retracts, depresses and upwardly rotates the scapula

labels.name: Latissimus dorsi
labels.function: Extends, adducts and medially rotates the arm; thoracodorsal n.

labels.name: Levator scapulae
labels.function: Elevates the scapula; dorsal scapular nerve

labels.name: Rhomboid minor
labels.function: Smaller, upper retractor of the scapula from C7-T1

labels.name: Rhomboid major
labels.function: Larger, lower retractor and stabilizer of the scapula

labels.name: Serratus posterior inferior
labels.function: Assists rib depression (T9-T12 intercostal nn.); mostly proprioceptive

labels.name: Sternocleidomastoid
labels.function: Rotates the head to the opposite side; short in torticollis

labels.name: Splenius capitis
labels.function: Bilaterally extends the head; unilaterally turns it to the same side

labels.name: Semispinalis capitis
labels.function: Transversospinalis muscle that roofs the suboccipital region

labels.name: Spinalis
labels.function: Most medial erector spinae column

labels.name: Longissimus
labels.function: Intermediate erector spinae column

labels.name: Iliocostalis
labels.function: Most lateral erector spinae column, slipping onto the ribs

labels.name: Multifidus
labels.function: Key lumbar stabilizer; weak in mechanical low back pain

labels.name: Interspinales
labels.function: Tiny segmental muscle joining adjacent vertebrae in the midline

labels.name: Intertransversarii
labels.function: Tiny segmental muscle between neighboring lateral vertebral projections

labels.name: Vertebral body
labels.function: Anterior weight-bearing part, largest in the lumbar region

labels.name: Vertebral foramen
labels.function: Stacked openings forming the canal that houses the cord and roots

labels.name: Pedicle
labels.function: Its notches help form the intervertebral foramen

labels.name: Transverse process
labels.function: Paired lateral arch projection for muscle and ligament attachment

labels.name: Superior articular process
labels.function: Forms a facet joint with the vertebra above

labels.name: Lamina
labels.function: Arch plate between the transverse and spinous projections

labels.name: Spinous process
labels.function: Midline posterior projection; at C7 it is palpable (prominens)

labels.name: Psoas major
labels.function: Flexes the hip; Pott disease can spread into its compartment

labels.name: Quadratus lumborum
labels.function: Fixes the 12th rib; laterally flexes the trunk to the same side

labels.name: Erector spinae
labels.function: Main extensor of the vertebral column; maintains upright posture

labels.name: Multifidus
labels.function: Deep transversospinalis stabilizer hugging the spinous process
